item: Countdown: a unit that has reached zero
reason: Divi dims it (source): Divi 5.15.1 Divi/style-static.min.css has `.et_pb_countdown_timer .section.zero p{opacity:.4}`, so a past end date, and every unit at 00 near the end of a real deadline, prints faint numbers. Observed in the Task 16 recipe render (the cta-countdown recipe with a past date failed the contrast check at 1.8 to 2.5:1), not a separate candidate. The rc-cd-* candidates use Divi's own past default end date and compare colours, sizes and families only; no setting was probed against the dimming

not probed and not to be used: it needs a Google Maps API key (`et_pb_get_google_api_key()`, Divi 5.15.1 includes/builder-5/server/Packages/ModuleLibrary/Map/MapModule.php:182) and enqueues Google's script from maps.googleapis.com (MapModule.php:183-207), a third-party request the plugin never adds
